key_inputs: Final polls of six pollsters, fieldwork 8-22 Oct 2026, recency-weighted, on a candidates-only base
Correction for past poll errors: Radev camp under-polled in 2016, 2021 and April 2026 (+2.2 to Iotova), runner-up/PP-DB camp (-1.5 to Gyurov), Vazrazhdane (-0.5 to Kostadinov), shrunk by 0.6
'I do not support anyone' 2.8 % from polls offering it and the 2021 first round (2.27 %)
Turnout 39.5 % of voters on the lists from pollsters' expectations (38.1-40 %) and 2021 (40.30 %)
Official CIK results by polling section of 19 Apr 2026 and 14 Nov 2021 for the municipal layer

sources.used_for: Sova Harris poll, fieldwork 13 – 17 Oct 2026, n=1000
Market Links poll, fieldwork 13 – 19 Oct 2026, n=1006
Alpha Research poll, fieldwork 18 – 22 Oct 2026, n=1000
poll table as of 25 Oct 01:00 UTC (before the polls opened)
mirror of CIK section results (Apr 2026, Nov 2021) and archived poll errors 2016-2026; commit of 01:44 UTC
original source of the April 2026 section data, counted in full on 20 Apr (the site blocks scripts; read through the mirror)

notes: Recency-weighted average of the six final polls, corrected for the repeated under-polling of the Radev camp and over-polling of the anti-Radev runner-up, then put on the base of all valid ballots with 'I do not support anyone' at 2.8 %. Ranges come from the residual errors of past Bulgarian final polls (heavy-tailed). With turnout expected near 40 % a first-round win is legally impossible unless turnout exceeds 50 %, so a runoff on 1 Nov is near-certain.
